coverage.note: Counts describe supplied footage only. Each required difficult stratum needs positive footage; sample counts do not establish CCTV generalization.

limitations: All labels are source plus Codex visual review; staff has not confirmed them.
AIRTLab uses new scene numbers/camera-sibling groups but shares room and actors with historical development data; it does not establish unseen-school/environment accuracy.
HMDB sports/solo-game cuts are short; no looping, padding, or synthetic frames used.
Play comprises hand-clapping games and solo Wii game, with no verified roughhousing/joking-pushing source.
One crowd source is time-lapse with strong motion blur; overhead crowd has tiny people and a stock-preview watermark.
Assistance includes real runner collapse/peer support and a caregiver equipment demonstration; only one selected clip explicitly shows collapse followed by support.
No unknown upstream pretraining exposure or unrecorded provenance can be ruled out.
